citations.claim: pole falls past limit at first violating step, with high system energy from unstable oscillation
one step before failure pole already at -0.619 rad with large negative rate, energy already inflated
four steps before failure oscillation already diverging with high cart velocity

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.014549496026817635 to 0.0; all else identical. Noisy angle/rate feedback at near-max dt destabilizes the controller, so removing noise stabilizes the run.

explanation: Seeded sensor noise (~0.0145) corrupts theta/omega feedback at near-max dt (~0.0194). Controller reacts to noisy measurements with large forces (22-37N), pumping energy (energy ~16 at step 30 rising to ~32 at step 34) into growing oscillations (theta 0.47 at step 20, omega -8 at step 30) until pole whips past 0.8 rad to -0.853 at step 34. Removing only the noise removes the failure.
vision_note: The pole leans progressively farther to the right from steps 31 to 33 while the cart stays near center. At step 34 it snaps violently to a steep left tilt and turns red, indicating the upright limit was exceeded.
